caption: Preview seven nodes and four PNG images before the import.
eval: (async () => { document.body.removeClass('theme-dark'); document.body.addClass('theme-light'); app.workspace.trigger('css-change'); const p = app.plugins.plugins['cherrytree-import']; p.modal?.close(); app.setting.close(); app.workspace.leftSplit.collapse(); const xml = await app.vault.read(app.vault.getFileByPath('CherryTree Import/cherry-small-fixture.ctd')); p.pro.signOut(); p.openImport(xml, 'cherry-small-fixture.ctd'); const transfer = new DataTransfer(); transfer.items.add(new File([xml], 'cherry-small-fixture.ctd', { type: 'application/xml' })); document.querySelector('.cherrytree-import-modal input[type=file]').files = transfer.files; if (document.querySelectorAll('.cherrytree-import-tree li').length !== 7) throw new Error('Wrong preview count'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The child note bbb has the table header first.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['cherrytree-import']; p.modal?.close(); app.setting.close(); app.workspace.leftSplit.collapse(); const xml = await app.vault.read(app.vault.getFileByPath('CherryTree Import/cherry-small-fixture.ctd')); p.pro.signOut(); if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('CherryTree demo')) await p.importXml(xml, 'cherry-small-fixture.ctd', { folder: 'CherryTree demo' }); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: { file: "CherryTree demo/aaa/bbb.md", mode: "preview" } }); const fe = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('file-explorer')[0]; const child = app.vault.getFileByPath('CherryTree demo/aaa/bbb.md'); if (fe && child) { app.workspace.leftSplit.expand(); await app.workspace.revealLeaf(fe); fe.view.revealInFolder(child); } return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro adds tags and a creation date.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['cherrytree-import']; p.modal?.close(); app.setting.close(); app.workspace.leftSplit.collapse(); const xml = await app.vault.read(app.vault.getFileByPath('CherryTree Import/cherry-small-fixture.ctd')); p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('cherrytree-import-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('CherryTree Pro demo')) await p.importXml(xml, 'cherry-small-fixture.ctd', { folder: 'CherryTree Pro demo', properties: true, indexes: true }); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: { file: "CherryTree Pro demo/aaa.md", mode: "preview" } }); return 'ok'; })()
